title: Log failed sign-ins
description: Ops wants to see credential-stuffing attempts on the dashboard, which reads the server log. POST /api/auth/login now logs each failed sign-in with the email tried. Includes tests and a README note.

comments.issue: It logs the whole request body, including the password that was tried, often the user's real password with a typo or one from another site; log only the email (and IP), never the password.
